title: EntropyMoE：基于熵感知的稀疏专家路由用于无分词器大语言模型
summary: EntropyMoE是一种针对动态字节补丁的混合专家（MoE）架构，利用补丁熵作为路由信号，实现稀疏条件计算，在保持下游精度的同时降低每字节比特数，扩展了MoE在无分词器模型中的应用。
summary_en: EntropyMoE is a Mixture-of-Experts architecture for dynamic byte patches, using patch entropy as routing signal for sparse computation, achieving lower bits-per-byte while maintaining accuracy, extending MoE beyond tokenizer-based models.
